messages:
elaine: quick heads-up — PR #8421 (kv-cache routing + kv-cache migration) is blocked on arch/design signoff. RFC linked below, pls review when you can.

ajay: thanks, can you paste the RFC link? want to check the fallback and migration tradeoffs.

elaine: sure — https://redwood.infra/rfcs/2025-09-kv-cache-routing (see "Shard mapping & fallback" section)

kevin: skimmed the code earlier, tests mostly good. main open concern is the shard mapping change — we need explicit consistency/migration guarantees spelled out in RFC before merge. @design-bot can you confirm if current RFC covers that?

design-bot: RFC 2025-09 updated 2025-09-12. Key section: "Shard mapping & fallback" outlines deterministic mapping + phased migration. Link: https://redwood.infra/rfcs/2025-09-kv-cache-routing#shard-mapping

ajay: ok, i'm fine with design if we add a short canary plan (10% -> monitor 5m error rate -> roll forward/rollback). can that be a 3-line appendix?

kevin: will add the canary config to the PR (simple rollout script + prometheus alerts). CI note: ci-bot shows integration flake, rerunning now.

ci-bot: CI pipeline: https://ci.redwood.dev/builds/8421 — unit ✅, integration ❌ (env timeout). Rerun queued.

elaine: process-wise: PR stays WIP until arch signoff + eng-platform approval. need arch label and design-bot signoff. @ajay can you do arch LGTM after your scan?

ajay: can do after lunch. if RFC contains the migration steps in a paragraph i'll give LGTM. :+1:

kevin: pushing canary config and a short migration appendix to the RFC now. aiming to update by EOD PST.

elaine: thanks. I'll update the PR description with direct RFC anchors and call out the rollback plan. leave it in ready-for-review once the canary config is pushed.

ajay: ACK — review scheduled ~13:30 PST.

kevin: CI rerun passed — integration ✅. merge gate is arch label.

design-bot: design signoff requested by @elaine. Current RFC version includes migration appendix v1. For unresolved major issues, please open a follow-up issue.

elaine: perfect. once @ajay drops arch:approved label and CI stays green, we can merge. thanks everyone.
